title: Close M7 documentary coverage review and qualify bounded follow-up program
commitMessage: docs: close M7 C02 coverage and program review

contribution.summary: Complete M7-W02-C02-T2 Q/O/D and close the accepted C02 document phase with an independently checked owner, source and follow-up program decision. Retain M7-W02 and M7 open, with 541 native nodes, three unsent recipient drafts and evidence-backed advanced/formal provider deferrals; do not infer a delivered product, public package or external approval.
contribution.value: A BCL-only C# checker verifies RS120 success attempt 001 with two pre-attempt refusals, the T1 SHA-pinned inventory, all 106 requirement IDs with 53 owners, 20 sources, six dispositions and four local gates, 541 native DWF nodes, three still-unsent requests and prior M7 provider nonclaims. A canonical C02 decision and concise program matrix classify remaining migration/rights/scientific gates. Only T2 Q/O/D and the C02 document parent transition to done; work package, release, future programs and recipients remain unapproved.
debtChanges: A completed document/research node is not proof that each accepted mathematical API is publicly implemented or that a public 1.2.0 package exists.
AURA, Decision and MCDM owner requests remain drafts, unsent and unacknowledged; pinned recipients, compatibility, migration and rollback require separate authorization.
Precision/interval, tensor, DAG, PlotModel and external formal-kernel providers remain deferred pending named consumers, trusted-base/error/resource and licensing gates.
The M7-W02 work package and M7 milestone/publication remain in progress; a candidate follow-up program is not approved or scheduled.
contribution.nextAction: After verified RS121 success, separately qualify M7-W02 work-package closure from C01/C02 receipts and outstanding recipient gaps. Require an independent owner/scientific/rights review before any M7 release, cross-repository transmission or new roadmap admission.
